# Tailgate Talks

> 12 free, printable 5-minute toolbox talks for HAZWOPER crews: buddy system, decon, heat stress, air monitoring, drums, confined spaces and more.

Tailgate Talks (https://toolbox-talks.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 8-Hour Refresher, HAZWOPER Supervisor, Supervisor Refresher, 40-Hour HAZWOPER training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://toolbox-talks.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

Leading crews and briefings. Enroll: https://toolbox-talks.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597

The annual supervisor refresher. Enroll: https://toolbox-talks.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-refresher-training?buy=596
